meta.scope: Saudi Arabia Batch 7 — Residual densification: education, health (life expectancy), and climate (GHG).

candidates.title: Education enrolment and literacy statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on education participation, attainment and literacy. Adult literacy is very high (near 98%); youth participation in education and training is substantial; mean years of schooling have risen under long-term investment.

candidates.title: Life expectancy and health outcome statistics
candidates.description: Life expectancy at birth and related health indicators. Life expectancy is in the mid-to-high 70s; non-communicable diseases dominate the mortality profile.

candidates.title: Greenhouse gas emissions statistics
candidates.description: National GHG emissions estimates. Energy and oil-related activities dominate the emissions profile; the series is referenced in climate policy, NDC and energy-transition discussions under Vision 2030.
candidates.notes: Core climate-measurement node under oil dominance.
